additionalRules: When writing an Army List for The Shire, if the Army contains only Hero models a player can either have models in a single Warband or as multiple smaller warbands as normal.

specialRules.name: Bilbo's Magic Ring
specialRules.text: In this Army List, Bilbo carries the One Ring instead of Frodo.

specialRules.name: "This'll be a night to remember"
specialRules.text: Friendly models may re-roll failed Courage Tests. Additionally, friendly models cannot have their Courage Tests reduced by the special rules or Magical Powers of enemy models.

specialRules.name: The Grey Wizard
specialRules.text: Friendly models may benefit from Gandalf's Stand Fast. Additionally, Gandalf may use two fireworks each Shoot Phase rather than one, though they must be different fireworks and target different models.

specialRules.name: A Long-expected Party
specialRules.text: Friendly models will pass a Fate Roll on a 3+ rather than a 4+. Additionally, friendly models may re-roll failed Fate Rolls.

specialRules.name: Glamdring
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Glamdring.

specialRules.name: Narya
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Gandalf may re-roll any failed Fate Rolls.

specialRules.name: Gandalf's Rockets
specialRules.text: At the start of every friendly Shoot Phase, Gandalf may select a firework, choose one enemy model he has Line of Sight to within 6" of his cart, and roll a D6. On a 2+, the chosen model suffers the effect of the firework. No In The Way Rolls are required.

specialRules.name: Mithril Coat
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Mithril armour. The wearer may re-roll Fate rolls of a 1.

specialRules.name: Sting
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Sting.

specialRules.name: Slip Away
specialRules.text: Whilst Bilbo is wearing the One Ring and is Invisible, enemy models Engaged in Combat with Bilbo will halve their Fight Value even if there are other models friendly to Bilbo Engaged in the same Combat.

specialRules.name: Get out of my fields!
specialRules.text: Whilst within range of an Objective Marker, Farmer Maggot does not suffer the -1 penalty to his Duel rolls for using a two-handed weapon.

specialRules.name: Loyal Hounds
specialRules.text: Grip, Fang and Wolf will always use Farmer Maggot's Courage characteristic whilst he is alive and on the battlefield. They treat Farmer Maggot as a banner with a range of 6", and may re-roll failed To Wound Rolls whilst within 6" of him.

specialRules.name: Pitchfork
specialRules.text: A Pitchfork can either be used as a spear or a two-handed weapon.

specialRules.name: "This is our Country"
specialRules.text: Friendly Hobbit models within 3" of Farmer Cotton may re-roll any rolls of a 1 when making a Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: Leave my Flowers Alone!
specialRules.text: After both sides have deployed, Hamfast's controlling player may place three 25mm Flower Markers anywhere on the board. Friendly Hobbit models may re-roll failed To Wound Rolls when Striking or shooting at an enemy model within 3" of a friendly Flower Marker; Hamfast gains +1 To Wound in the same circumstance.

units.name: Paladin Took, Thain of the Shire

specialRules.name: To me, Shire-folk!
specialRules.text: Paladin's Stand Fast has a range of 12"; however, only friendly Hobbit models may benefit from Paladin's Stand Fast.

specialRules.name: For Tuckborough!
specialRules.text: Friendly Tookish Hunters within 6" of Paladin gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Frying Pan
specialRules.text: Instead of making Strikes if he wins a Duel Roll, Sam may use his Frying Pan: choose one enemy Infantry model involved in the Combat and roll a D6. On a 4+, the chosen model is stunned and cannot Move during the following turn.

units.name: Will Whitfoot, Mayor of Michel Delving

specialRules.name: Mayor of Michel Delving
specialRules.text: At the beginning of a Fight Phase, Will Whitfoot can spend a Will Point to give friendly Hobbit Warrior models within 3" a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value until the End Phase of the turn.

specialRules.name: Family Rivalry
specialRules.text: Lotho may not take part in any Heroic Actions declared by either Bilbo Baggins or Frodo Baggins.

specialRules.name: Considerable Wealth
specialRules.text: Lotho may spend his Will Points to grant friendly Hobbits within 3" +1 Fight Value, friendly Ruffians within 3" Fearless, or force a Charging enemy model to stop 1" away on a D6 roll of 2+.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader.

specialRules.name: High Spirits
specialRules.text: Whenever a friendly Hobbit model within 6" of Folco spends a Might Point, they may roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Might Point spent is free.

specialRules.name: A Helpful Sort
specialRules.text: If Folco is within 3" of Frodo, then Frodo can spend Folco's Will Points to declare a Heroic Move instead of using one of his own Might Points.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader.

specialRules.name: Live to fight another day
specialRules.text: If Fredegar attempts to Charge an enemy model with the Terror special rule and fails the Courage Test, then Fredegar may still Move as normal; however, he may not Charge any model that turn.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader.

specialRules.name: Umbrella
specialRules.text: This is a hand weapon. If Lobelia wins a Combat she may not make Strikes.

specialRules.name: Furious Tirade
specialRules.text: Enemy Warrior models cannot benefit from a Hero model's Stand Fast whilst within 6" of Lobelia.

specialRules.name: A Stern Scolding
specialRules.text: Once per turn, Lobelia can spend a Will Point: choose an enemy model within 6" and Line of Sight and roll a D6. On a 2+, the chosen model cannot Activate this turn and treats its Attacks as 1 if it fights that turn.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader.

specialRules.name: For the Shire!
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of Boromir of Gondor, Merry may spend Boromir's Might Points as if they were his own.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader.

specialRules.name: For the Shire!
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of Boromir of Gondor, Pippin may spend Boromir's Might Points as if they were his own.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader.

specialRules.name: "If I were to marry anyone, it would've been her"
specialRules.text: Whilst Sam is within 3" of Rosie, Sam may re-roll any failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: "Sweet Maiden of the Golden Ale"
specialRules.text: Friendly Hobbit models treat Rosie Cotton as a banner with a range of 6". Additionally, so long as she is alive, Rosie will also count as a banner for Victory Points purposes.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub The Shire army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text for all units from The Free Peoples faction page.
